summary.name: Petalica Paint
summary.one_liner: Petalica Paint (formerly PaintsChainer) was an AI-assisted line art colouring service from Preferred Networks that is being discontinued on July 31, 2025.
use_cases: adding shading and lighting to illustrations
creating commercial artwork with AI colouring
summary.what_it_does: Petalica Paint, previously named PaintsChainer, is a web service that applies AI painting to drawings. The page mentions a painting style called "Canna" that is especially good at shading and lighting. It also offers a "Sketch Simplification" tool that extracts and refines the strokes of sketches. The service was renamed from PaintsChainer to Petalica Paint three years after its launch, and its terms were revised to allow commercial use. The operator changed from Preferred Networks to pixiv Inc. in November 2019. The page announces that the service will be discontinued on July 31, 2025 at 4:00 PM JST, after which all services become unavailable.
notable: Sketch Simplification tool for extracting and refining sketch strokes
Canna painting style, strong at shading and lighting
Terms revised to allow commercial use
Service moved from PaintsChainer to Petalica Paint, now discontinued
caveats: Service discontinued as of July 31, 2025 at 4:00 PM JST; all services become unavailable afterward
Page does not clearly state pricing; 'free' is inferred only from the lack of any stated paid tier, so it is not confirmed
